messages:
maya: RFC: sampling protocol for RBAC change evidence for upcoming SOC 2/ISO audit. Need guidance on which log slices to include (rolebindings, token issuance, iam policy changes), and KMS key provenance for service accounts. CC @samir @alex @auditor_jane

samir: Short answer: include rolebinding changes, service-account key ops, token minting and authz decisions. We should pull CloudTrail/Cloud Audit logs + k8s audit logs. Suggest initial sample = 5% of events per month per control, stratified by user/service.

alex: Agree. Also capture config snapshots of iam/rolebindings at sample times. We'll add signed manifest with SHA256 of exported artifacts. Example export command:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2026-02-01 --end-time 2026-02-28 --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AttachRolePolicy > /tmp/ct-events.json
shasum -a 256 /tmp/ct-events.json
```

auditor_jane: For auditor: Do you have chain-of-custody showing who exported the logs and when? Also need proof of key origin for KMS—was key created in customer account or imported? Can you provide KMS key creation event and policy attachment?

maya: Yes — plan is to include an 'evidence_manifest.csv' with fields: export_ts, exporter, file_path, sha256, sampling_basis. Also include KMS CreateKey event + key policy + grant events. For imported keys we'll include import-token artifacts.

samir: On KMS provenance: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key>` plus CloudTrail `CreateKey` event works. If key was imported, there's an `ImportKeyMaterial` event and source shows `Origin: EXTERNAL`. Also show KMS key policy snapshots. We should redact customer data.

alex: For k8s RBAC, export `kubectl get clusterrolebinding,rolebinding -o yaml --all-namespaces` at sample times. Also include audit sink snippet and filter rule we used: `user.username!=system:serviceaccount:kube-system` to reduce noise.

compliance-bot: evidence-index updated: /evidence/2026-02/manifest-2475001234.csv :thumbsup:

auditor_jane: One more Q: How do you handle emergency/expedited RBAC grants (on-call escalation)? Need detailed entries showing approval/justification + time-boundedness.

maya: We have an emergency grant runbook. We'll include playbook excerpt and the Slack escalation thread IDs, plus the approval ticket IDs from JIRA. Each emergency grant export will be flagged in manifest as 'emergency=true' and include approval artifacts.

samir: Note: for statistical sampling, use stratified random sampling by principal type (human/service/bot) and by action severity (modify/create/delete). Target 95% confidence for key controls -> ~150 samples per control over 12 months; we can relax to 30/month if auditor accepts.

auditor_jane: Sounds good. Please upload the first bundle by EOD Friday. Also include hash bundle signed by a security team GPG key.
